an4.135:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo sāvajjo hoti?
an4.135:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sāvajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti . . . pe . . . sāvajjo manokammena samannāgato hoti.
an4.135:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sāvajjo hoti. 3.
an4.135:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo vajjabahulo hoti?
an4.135:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sāvajjena bahulaṃ kāyakammena samannāgato hoti appaṃ anavajjena . . .
an4.135:3.4: sāvajjena bahulaṃ manokammena samannāgato hoti appaṃ anavajjena.
an4.135:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo appavajjo hoti?
an4.135:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo anavajjena bahulaṃ kāyakammena samannāgato hoti appaṃ sāvajjena . . .
an4.135:4.4: anavajjena bahulaṃ manokammena samannāgato hoti appaṃ sāvajjena.
an4.135:4.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo appavajjo hoti. 5.
an4.135:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo anavajjo hoti?
an4.135:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo anavajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti . . . pe . . . anavajjena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
an4.135:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo anavajjo hoti.
an4.135:5.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 136. 1.
